Marco-Bench-MIF: A Benchmark for Multilingual Instruction-Following Evaluation
	





	
		
	
	
		Introduction
	

Marco-Bench-MIF is the first deeply localized multilingual benchmark designed to evaluate instruction-following capabilities across 30 languages. Unlike existing benchmarks that rely primarily on machine translation, Marco-Bench-MIF implements fine-grained cultural adaptations to provide more accurate assessment.
